display_name: Three items in the Compensation to Victims of Hostile Actions Law, 5730-1970, recorded as typed values with their tests: a word in the list of s 4(א) that the consolidation prints and an official instruction deletes, a number in the list of s 7(א) whose section an official instrument repeals, and the place a text puts a grant of 200,000 new shekels; not an encoding of the Law
domain_expert_review: none: no domain expert has read this against the source
seat: the injured person, or the relative of a person who died, to whom the Law gives compensation. The row asks no question from the seat because it records three items and their controls, not rules.

source.note: the deposits are excerpts of unofficial consolidations; a reading is CONSOLIDATION-ONLY unless NOTES.md says it was read from a page of an instrument. The official pages read are in official/ as cropped band images, named by instrument and printed page.

expected_red.note: six assertions, two for each of three items. I1: every entry the consolidation prints in the list of s 4(א) is one that no official instruction read by this row deletes (FALSE), and the number of entries printed and deleted is 0 (it is 1). I2: every entry printed in the list of s 7(א) names a section that no official instrument read by this row repeals (FALSE), and the number of entries printed whose section is repealed is 0 (it is 1). I3: the consolidation and the 2016 instrument put the 200,000-shekel grant in the same law (FALSE) and in the same section (FALSE)

run.method: one builder, from a written brief; the page images named in NOTES.md were looked at by the builder
